exposure: bilateral internal iliac arteries balloon occlusion
outcome: estimated surgical blood loss (EBL) over 3500 mL
cohort: 199 women with singleton pregnancies after 28 weeks of gestation, complicated by placenta previa and pathologically confirmed placenta accreta spectrum, who underwent hysterectomy during cesarean sections from January 2012 to August 2023.
finding: Emergency surgery, cervical invasion of the placenta, and intraoperative bladder injury were identified as potential risk factors for estimated surgical blood loss exceeding 3500 mL during cesarean hysterectomy in women with placenta previa accreta.
mod_finding: Emergency surgery was identified as a risk factor for excessive estimated surgical blood loss during cesarean hysterectomy.
